messages:
ingrid (support): FYI customer 'Maplytics' reports a spike of 503s from hosted API when they hit the heatmap endpoint at ~200rps, high severity customer call happening now

maria (infra): Noted. Any logs or sample request ids?

ingrid (support): sent request ids in thread — 8a3f/8a40/8a41, stacktrace attached from their side, but we see mirrored 503s in our gateway logs.

maria (infra): I pulled the gateway traces: lots of upstream 503s with "upstream read error" and abrupt connection close. Forwarding runner pod logs.

jeff (eng-runtime): from runner logs: repeated coredump-like prints then container restart. Last lines: `terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_alloc'` then `SIGBUS` on addr 0x7f4a8... looks like GPU pagefault/kern.

oncall-bot: Incident created: I-5543219876 - hosted-infer 503 spike - paging oncall@sre

sanjay (sre): Correlating node metrics: GPU mem usage spikes right before crash, NVML reports ECC errors on node gpu-pool-7, pmon shows PCIe errors too. Repro step looks like high-context heatmap generation + toolcall that requests large image embed.

maria (infra): Can we triage model + batch sizes? Which model were they hitting?

ingrid (support): Customer says model: open-vision-xl-13b, context ~4600 tokens + image toolcall.

jeff (eng-runtime): That model + long context + image toolcall should fit normally but combined KV prefetch + image tensor upload may push memory. Recent kernel build (r54) changed prefetch scheduling — suspect regression.

maria (infra): Mitigation: I've flipped routing for Maplytics to fallback smaller variant (open-vision-xl-7b) and disabled prefetch for their route. Pushed policy at 5543219999.

ingrid (support): Customer confirms 503s drop after fallback, latency up ~80ms but acceptable. They're on call and calm for now.

jeff (eng-runtime): For repro I attempted a local run: reproduced SIGBUS after a few requests when combining long prompt + image toolcall. Stack: `libcudnn.so` mmio map faults then `runtime.cc:421 allocator->alloc_gpu`.

sanjay (sre): I'll cordon gpu-pool-7 and evacuate pods from that host to rule out hardware flakiness. Scheduling maintenance window.

maria (infra): Created debug job to reproduce at scale with same image sizes and context lengths. Job id dbg-554321. Collecting nvml, kernel messages, coredumps.

jeff (eng-runtime): Quick patch candidate: guard allocator with retry on transient pagefaults + fallback to CPU copy path. Will open PR and can hotfix if we confirm this is software.

sanjay (sre): If hardware errors persist after evac, we'll engage cloud infra to RMA GPU. For now keep fallback routing until we have a reliable repro and CI test.

ingrid (support): Notes for CS: communicate mitigation + ETA. We should offer credit if they suffered downtime >5m during peak.

maria (infra): Action items: (1) keep fallback route live (until 5543221200), (2) collect full coredump and nvml logs (dbg-554321), (3) PR for allocator retry (jeff), (4) hardware evac + RMA if errors persist (sanjay).

jeff (eng-runtime): PR opened: https://git.internal/r/infer/allocator/merge/432 - includes unit test and opt-in flag.

oncall-bot: Update: I-5543219876 status=mitigated, severity=high, owner=maria (infra)

ingrid (support): Closing loop with customer: they acknowledged mitigation, will monitor. Marking incident as customer-handled but keeping triage open until debug job completes. :white_check_mark:
